## Problem and resulting change

Explain the gap, the resulting guidance, and the affected files. Link an issue if applicable.

## Evidence and licensing

List sources and precise locations for substantive claims, or explain why none are needed. Record attribution and applicable licenses for third-party material.

## Validation

Describe checks performed and their results. Keep automated results separate from independent review.

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and kept the change focused and content-only.
- [ ] Changed links and paths resolve; any changed JSON parses.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check` and inspected the changed files.
- [ ] Applicable indexes and attribution records are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, unsupported completion claims, or proprietary material are included.
- [ ] Commits include the contributor sign-off required by CONTRIBUTING.md.

## Limits or follow-up

Name unresolved findings, or state that none are known.
